Chapter 934: Chapter 2: Upload Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 934: Chapter 2: Upload Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter (Request for Subscription)

“Discovered?”

Lin Yuan did not panic, quickly retracting his perception.

As long as the other party’s Fusion of Time and Space does not reach the Seventh Realm, at most they might faintly detect Lin Yuan’s surveillance. As for pinpointing Lin Yuan’s location?

It’s basically impossible.

That’s the advantage of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, the initiative completely in Lin Yuan’s hands.

If it weren’t for worrying about the Robber Clan using some means to attack through space and time along the perception, Lin Yuan would not even retract his perception.

…

In the deepest parts of the Robber Clan’s territory, in an unknowable place, in front of a mysterious cabin.

The figure who stepped out from the door stood there, looking around with a heavy gaze.

“What’s going on?”

A voice came from inside the cabin, seemingly puzzled.

“I felt that a powerful being was spying on us.” The figure standing outside the cabin slowly said.

“Spying on us?” The voice inside the cabin silenced for a while, “The ancestral cabin is the foundation of our Robber Clan, could these young twelfth-tier beings of this Cosmic Era actually detect the existence of the ancestral cabin?”

The strongest foundation of the Robber Clan is this ancestral cabin, which is why they could survive from the last Cosmic Era to this one.

“I indeed felt I was being spied on.” The figure outside the cabin asserted, “Detecting the existence of the ancestral cabin must at least be at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, and possibly with the aid of a powerful spatiotemporal treasure.”

“Path Splitting Realm peak…” The voice inside the cabin solemnly said, “The Cosmic Era is far from over, how has a twelfth-tier at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm emerged so quickly?”

Normally, in a complete Cosmic Era, it is rare to see the birth of a twelfth-tier at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

Even if one appeared, it is usually close to the end of the Cosmic Era. Currently, not even one-tenth of the Cosmic Era has passed, there simply aren’t conditions for the birth at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

“If not at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, who could detect the ancestral cabin?” The figure outside the cabin said quietly.

Even if possessing a powerful spatiotemporal treasure, one must also have the corresponding realm and comprehension of space-time to activate it.

And the threshold for the latter is the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

Of course, comprehension of space-time reaching the Seventh Realm could also achieve it.

But the Seventh Realm of space-time… is much harder to reach than the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

Neither the voice inside the cabin nor the figure outside considered this possibility.

…

“The figure that emerged from the cabin must be one of the Robber Clan’s two twelfth-tiers.” Lin Yuan quickly retracted his perception, thinking rapidly.

The Robber Clan only has two twelfth-tiers, but they suppress the other top eleven peak clans from making any moves because these two twelfth-tiers are both at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

“The Robber Clan… poses no threat to me.” Lin Yuan pondered for a while; the two twelfth-tiers of the Robber Clan, despite having the strength to suppress other ultimate twelfth-tiers, dare not fully exert their power.

Because the real enemies of the Robber Clan’s two twelfth-tiers are the cosmic consciousness, if they fully exert their power, they’d be directly suppressed by the cosmic consciousness.

The consciousness of the Immortal Realm commands the power of the Immortal Realm, capable of suppressing beings like the Ancestor of the Immortal Path at the twelfth-tier.

The cosmos are a hundred times vast than the Immortal Realm, and the cosmic consciousness can easily suppress life at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

…

After roughly gaining insight into the Cosmic Starry Skies, Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluttered slightly, and he arrived at a large battlefield.

“Eternal Spatial Rift…”

Lin Yuan looked towards the rift connecting the cosmos to the outside not far away.

“My perception can cross the spatial rift…” As Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted, outside the cosmos, the vast Chaos Void gathered strands of Chaotic Power, forming a figure.

It was Lin Yuan’s avatar.

“Not subjected to the cosmos’ backlash…” Lin Yuan constantly observed the surroundings.

Though ultimate existences of the twelfth tier are not allowed to leave the Cosmic Starry Skies, that refers to their true bodies.

If it’s just an avatar carrying not much energy, it can leave.

However, the significance isn’t very great.

Even for an ultimate twelfth-tier, whose comprehension of time-space stays at the Sixth Realm, even sending an avatar out of the cosmos, it cannot get too far.

Once it surpasses a certain range, the connection with the original body severs, and this avatar will collapse.

And within the Chaos Void, filled with omnipresent Chaos Qi, merely relying on the power of an avatar, it’s difficult to resist the erosion of the Chaos Qi, and even more impossible to last long.

But Lin Yuan is different.

His Seventh Realm understanding of space-time allows his avatar to maintain a connection with the Primordial Spirit of his true body even across vast distances.

After mastering the Chaos Rule, Lin Yuan’s avatar, formed entirely of Chaos Qi, enters the Chaos Void like a fish in water, without worrying about erosion.

“It could be useful to explore the Chaos Void with an avatar.” Lin Yuan smiled, the Chaos Void vast and boundless, containing countless opportunities.

Whether it’s the outer domain auroras, the White Paper containing two-dimensional worlds, or many ancient treasures that fell into the cosmos from earlier, all originate from the Chaos Void outside the cosmos.

Once Lin Yuan can explore the Chaos Void ahead of time, the help to himself would be unimaginably great.

Of course, while the Chaos Void contains countless opportunities, it is also very dangerous, but Lin Yuan is merely exploring with an avatar, and if he truly encounters an unstoppable danger, he can just dissipate the avatar.

…

“Is this the cosmos?”

Outside the cosmos, Lin Yuan turned back to look at the massive object behind him.

Even in the vast Chaos Void, the cosmos is an immensely massive celestial body, strong enough that not even rulers of realms can meddle with it.

In terms of size, the cosmos is on the same level as beings of the Chaos Realm.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan paused for a moment and then immediately chose a direction and started to explore towards the Chaos Void.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Taiyin Primordial Spirit was usually stationed here.

“Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter…”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, details about the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter emerging in his mind.

As early as in the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan had already fully developed the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter.

For the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter, Lin Yuan specifically established tens of thousands of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule models, as well as many other rule models.

This was also one of Lin Yuan’s greatest gains in the Immortal Realm, mastering hundreds of thousands of pillar-level fusion rules, surpassing those ultimate beings of human civilization in understanding the essence of many rules, which is why he could achieve what even ultimate beings had not accomplished.

Establishing Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule models from the First to Fifth Realm.

“With these rule models, future martial arts evolutionary paths will be much easier.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, having rule models as guidance is like having the right direction, and taking a shortcut, making the process much easier.

And the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule models established by Lin Yuan were not only applicable to martial arts evolutionaries, but also could be referenced by other evolutionary pathways, though the effects were not as significant.

Even so, Lin Yuan could imagine the impact of the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter on human civilization.

Nowadays, human civilization has not yet perfected the complete Rule of Time model, and the current Space-Time Rule model, even if fully understood, cannot fully comprehend the Rule of Time.

But Lin Yuan directly went further, establishing the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule model from the First to Fifth Realm?

“It’s almost done.”

Lin Yuan thought repeatedly, and after confirming that there were no omissions in the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter, he directly contacted the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Respected Tenth-Level Citizen Scholar Yuan, the Goddess of Wisdom is pleased to serve you.”

The solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom sounded.

“I want to upload the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter.” Lin Yuan said directly.

“Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter….” After a brief pause, the Goddess of Wisdom immediately responded, “Respected Tenth-Level Citizen Scholar Yuan, you can now upload…”

No sooner had the Goddess of Wisdom finished speaking.

Lin Yuan began to upload the well-prepared Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter.

Compared to the previous Martial Tao First Tier Chapter to Tenth Rank Chapter, the upload speed of the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter was much slower, mainly because the content information was too vast.

Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule models… even the simplest one occupies a space of information thousands to tens of thousands of times that of the earlier Martial Tao First Tier Chapter to Tenth Rank Chapter, not to mention the over thirty thousand Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule models established by Lin Yuan?

Besides the Space-Time Rule model, there were also many other rule models, including those more niche rule models.

After more than ten minutes.

Lin Yuan had finally uploaded the complete Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter.

“Respected Tenth-Level Citizen Scholar Yuan, please wait a moment…”

The Goddess of Wisdom, having received all contents of the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter, immediately began contacting the ultimate beings of human civilization.

As early as when Lin Yuan developed the Ninth Rank Chapter, the Goddess of Wisdom was unable to make the most objective judgments on the martial arts evolutionary path and needed the opinions of ultimate beings.

The Eleventh Rank Chapter was even more so.

…

Virtual World.

On the nine thrones, towering figures appeared one after another.

“Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter? Has the Galaxy Master young fellow already fully developed the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter?”

“Hahaha, I’m curious what the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter developed by the Galaxy Master looks like.”

“Indeed, from the First to Tenth Rank Chapter, truly stunning…”

Soon, all nine ultimate beings of human civilization gathered, all showing keen interest.

“You old guys…” Xia Qin, an ultimate being, rolled his eyes, “Don’t put too much pressure on the Galaxy Master, the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter is after all just the eleventh rank chapter, why are you so interested?”

Xia Qin wasn’t belittling Lin Yuan, but compared to the uplift the uploading of the Ninth and Tenth Rank Chapter brought to the martial arts evolutionary path.

The Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter might not be as significant as imagined.

Currently, the martial arts evolutionary path is ranked tenth in the human civilization evolution rankings, with the nine top ultimate evolutionary paths above it.

Even if ‘updated’ with the Eleventh Rank Chapter, it will definitely still be ranked tenth, unable to surpass any of the top ultimate evolutionary paths.

Even Xia Qin himself couldn’t figure out how to fully develop and perfect the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter to match the standards from the First to Ninth Rank Chapter.

“Xia Qin, you really care about the Galaxy Master.”

Void God, an ultimate being, said with a smile: “Since that’s the case, let’s watch the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter, just watch normally, without too many expectations.”

Upon hearing this, the other ultimate beings glanced at each other and nodded slightly.

While chatting casually, the Goddess of Wisdom had already sent the complete Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter to each of the ultimate beings.

“Eleventh Rank Chapter…”

Xia Qin, an ultimate being, watched it first, feeling a touch of nervousness in his heart.

However.

Just a few breaths into watching, Xia Qin’s expression changed.

“This?!”
